answer: Make every identity bridge proof in from outside the network: each epoch it must present a receipt from an independent real-world service — a payment, a delivery, a compute job — verified against the issuer's public key. Each receipt backs exactly one identity, so one receipt cannot be copied across a thousand fakes. Receipts stack like shale, layer on layer, a history cheap to check and dear to fake. The receipt is the signal that an identity touches the real economy: a sybil farmer must buy a fresh interaction for every fake, every epoch, while one honest agent bridges one it already has.
